_om: Vinglepetter in English (Dithers, rusj.no/en/dithers/) – Would you rather. «I vinglestolen» is «In the hot seat». Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. The dilemmas are in data.en/dilemmaer.json (two options after «Would you rather …»), written for the UK. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Ingen vingling – stå for valget!: No dithering – stand by your choice!
Bare én har stemt. Det får holde!: Only one vote. That’ll have to do!
Helt likt – nå må dere diskutere!: Dead even – now you’ll have to talk it out!
Én mot resten – forsvar deg!: One against the rest – defend yourself!
Dere er enige om nesten alt. Er dere sik: You agree on almost everything. Are you sure you’re not the same person?
Stort sett enige – med noen herlige ving: Mostly agreed – with a few lovely ditherers here and there.
Akkurat nok uenighet til at det ble gøy: Just enough disagreement to make it fun to argue.
Dere er uenige om nesten alt. Lykke til: You disagree on almost everything. Good luck choosing a pizza!
You know each other inside out.
The crew reads each other pretty well.
Some are open books, others are total riddles.
Nobody here is easy to read.

What do you think {navn} chose? Tap it.

Trykk på knappen. På «VELG!» holder alle: Press the button. On ‘CHOOSE!’ everyone holds up one finger ☝️ or two fingers ✌️ – all at once.
Trykk på hvor mange som valgte ☝️, så vi: Tap how many chose ☝️ and the phone shows the split. The minority gets to defend itself!

Ujevnt resultat? Gi mindretallet en fors: Uneven result? Give the minority a 20-second defence speech – maybe someone will switch sides.
Skru av «Tell stemmer» hvis dere bare vi: Turn off ‘Count votes’ if you just want to talk it over.
